```plato
    //==
    // # Polygon2D predicates and repair

    // True when the polygon satisfies the invariant its declaration states.
    IsSimple(p: Polygon2D): Boolean
        => p.Points.IsSimpleRing;
```

```plato
    // True when every ring of the region is simple and no two of them meet — the
    // structural half of the declaration's invariants. The other half, that the holes
    // lie inside the boundary, is `HolesLieInside`.
    IsSimple(r: PolygonWithHoles2D): Boolean
        => r.Boundary.IsSimple
        && r.Holes.All(h => h.IsSimple)
        && r.Holes.All(h => RingsAreDisjoint(r.Boundary.Points, h.Points))
        && r.Holes.Count.Range.All(i => r.Holes.Count.Range.All(j =>
            j > i ? RingsAreDisjoint(r.Holes[i].Points, r.Holes[j].Points) : true));
```
